_doc.max_turns: model calls allowed per problem before the run ends without an answer
_doc.nudges: times a reply with no tool call is answered with nudge.prompt instead of ending the run
_doc.remind_after: calculator calls after which each result also reminds the agent to submit (remind.prompt)
_doc.stop_after: calculator calls allowed before the run is stopped without an answer (stuck detection)
_doc.plan: whether the agent writes a plan before solving
_doc.calculator: whether the agent has the calculator tool
